svg.title: How a poly voice makes sound: DDS
svg.desc: Block chain from note to OCR2B, then aligned plots of the phase accumulator, the looked-up samples and the sum of two voices.
svg.text: How a poly voice makes sound: DDS
Direct digital synthesis at a fixed sample rate fs = 31.25 kHz (one sample every 32 µs).
main loop, once per Note On
TIMER0_COMPA ISR, every sample, for each sounding voice
Phase accumulator acc (one voice, f = 2.5 kHz)
each sample: acc += inc = 1 342 177; past 2²⁴ it wraps and the next period starts
Two voices (2.5 kHz + 3.75 kHz) summed into OCR2B (0…255)
